description: POST JSON to allowlisted HTTP endpoints (webhooks, APIs), with the auth token read from an env var.

inputs.prompt: Hosts the tool may POST to, comma-separated
inputs.help: Comma-separated hostnames the tools may call, e.g. hooks.example.com. Requests to any other host are refused before anything is sent.
Header that carries the token, e.g. Authorization or X-Api-Key.

inputs.prompt: Auth scheme before the token (empty = token only)
inputs.help: Text before the token in the header, e.g. Bearer. Leave empty to send the token alone.

inputs.prompt: Expose the generic http_post tool (on or off)
inputs.help: off leaves out the free-form http_post tool, so the model only gets http_get and spec-defined tools.
Never collected or written to disk. Set HTTP_ACTION_TOKEN in the MCP client entry.
